message.content: {"basis":"The state prevalence dashboard legend is inverted: pale yellow at the top is labeled “100 Low,” while dark burgundy at the bottom is labeled “0 High.” Comparing the three available option states on the map, NY is filled with the darkest burgundy (closest to the “0 High” end), DE is intermediate orange, and NC is pale yellow (closest to the “100 Low” end). Therefore, NY has the highest encoded prevalence among the options and is the record that should be routed into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.","option_label":"Open New York (NY) prevalence detail for priority follow-up"}
